name: KYA Rails
desc: Spending mandate for an AI agent enforced as assertMsg fences in a Daml choice body (cap, per-period limit, allow-list, expiry, revoke), with every attempt sealed into a hash-chained receipt including the ones the ledger refused. The chain verifies in a browser with no wallet or install, and its head is anchored on-ledger so a forged chain fails the check.
